settings.heading: How fast is delivery?
settings.row_content:
Orders placed before 12pm (Monday–Friday) are dispatched the same day via Royal Mail Tracked 48 or another 48-hour tracked courier.

Please allow up to 3 working days for delivery before contacting us.

Please note, orders are not shipped on weekends.

settings.heading: Are your plates road legal?
settings.row_content:
When placing your order, you can choose between Road Legal Plates or Show Plates.

Road legal plates are manufactured in line with UK regulations, including correct character spacing and required supplier markings to meet British Standards.

Show plates are supplied as entered, with custom spacing, options of tinted acrylics, Krystal/Neon digits and no legal markings, and are intended for display purposes only.

In the unlikely event your order arrives damaged or has been produced incorrectly, we will of course resolve this promptly.

settings.heading: What are Show Plates?
settings.row_content: Show plates are number plates made using legal components but intended for off-road or novelty use only. Tinted, coloured, and Krystal/Neon plates all fall under this category and are not road legal for use on UK roads, despite often being seen on vehicles. The only road-legal character colour permitted is black. All tinted, coloured, and Krystal/Neon plates supplied by Elite Plates are sold strictly as show plates for off-road use only.

settings.heading: PREMIUM QUALITY
settings.row_content: At Aplates, we exclusively use the highest-quality materials available on the market. We combine deluxe acrylic with laser-cut gloss black characters to produce our premium products. This formula has been tested extensively to maximise plate durability and retention.

settings.heading: 100% UK ROAD LEGAL & MOT COMPLIANT
settings.row_content: Unless they’re marked and advertised as Show plates, our number plates are completely legal for use on UK roads. Furthermore, they are also MOT compliant, so you can rest assured your personalised experience will be carefree.

settings.heading: DVLA REGISTERED MANUFACTURER
settings.row_content: As a DVLA-registered number plate supplier, we ensure our plates conform to the British Standard, BSAU 145e. If the registration has been spaced correctly by the customer and the character type selected is road legal, our plates will be made with the mandatory supplier details and the British Standard printed on the lower-middle and lower-right side areas of the plates.

settings.heading: ANPR CAMERA CERTIFIED – RIGOROUS TESTING
settings.row_content: Our plates undergo vigorous testing procedures to ensure they adhere to each and every legal parameter set out by the DVLA. This includes a state-of-the-art ANPR camera test, so you can rest assured we comply with Police regulations. Our plates have even been tested by our local constabulary, and we’re pleased to say they passed with flying colours.

settings.heading: PROFESSIONALLY LASER CUT
settings.row_content: We use cutting-edge laser technology to bring you the best quality plates available on the market.

settings.heading: HEAVY-DUTY DURABILITY
settings.row_content: Our plates have been tested extensively in order to maximise their durability and premium condition. As a result, the plates are weather-proof, and they can even withstand being jet-washed from distances over 1.5m.

settings.heading: EASY INSTALLATION WITH FREE STICKY PADS
settings.row_content: We include a free pack of sticky pads in your delivery for every plate ordered. These 10 strips provide an extremely strong grip which allows for a quick and easy installation.
